Manage file lock metrics that are accumulated in memory.

File lock metrics track lock acquisition times, contention rates, wait times, and system busyness.
Metrics are accumulated in memory and can be collected/flushed to create metric objects.

  View current buffered metrics
  zqk.test system metrics file-lock view
  Flush metrics to create a metric object
  zqk.test system metrics file-lock flush
  Flush with custom time window
  zqk.test system metrics file-lock flush --window 1h

Usage:
  zqk.test system metrics file-lock [command]

Available Commands:
  flush       Flush buffered metrics to create a metric object
  view        View current buffered file lock metrics

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk.test system metrics file-lock [command] --help" for more information about a command.
